desc:
Earn Coins when someone buys your avatar OR when you buy someone else's avatar!
Use your Coins to unlock avatar items you can wear in every Roblox game

How to Play:
• Claim a booth and display your outfits. ✨
• Browse and try on outfits before buying. 🛍️
• Earn Coins from outfit sales and purchases. 🎁
• Redeem your Coins for avatar accessories that stay in your Roblox inventory. 🎩

Publish Community Outfits to show your outfits globally and earn Coins from every sale! 
VIP Servers are FREE!

✅ All purchases made in-game will be available in your Roblox inventory & can be used in all games.
